pages.text: Fuel Cells: burnable cells crafted from Akaishi ingots - the reactor fuel.$(li)The Fuel Canner fills cells$(li)The Fuel Mixer blends end/dragon/world-base mixtures$(li)Fusion Fuel Aggregator builds fusion rods from rods$(li)The Plasma Filler loads plasma into rods -> Plasma Fuel Rods
Heat sinks come in 6 tiers (poor -> exquisite), plus fusion sinks (tier 1-5 + life).$(br)Crafted step by step from Cooling Base and powders - both reactor and fusion depend on them.
